title: Audit selected JSON locale failures without changing frozen sources
body:
The selected-result checker uses the locale codec for its record, certificate and source-manifest JSON. Complete UTF-8 fixtures fail on native Windows CPython 3.12.10 (cp1252): U+211D raises `UnicodeDecodeError`, and a Unicode input filename becomes mojibake. This package reproduces the failure, verifies `python -X utf8` on the unchanged checker, and tests a three-line explicit-encoding patch in private temporary copies.

The checker is itself pinned by `frontier6030-source.json`, so applying the patch directly would break the selected source closure. **Only `research/selected-json-utf8-replay/` is added.** The patch is reviewable evidence, not a modification to the selected checker. The current selected metadata passes its normal baseline; the failures use complete synthetic fixtures. No new kappa or mathematical claim.

### Evidence and reproduction

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-json-utf8-replay
```

- Eight test methods pass in ordinary and optimized-driver registered runs, including native cp1252 CLI execution without the portable codec mock. Checker children retain assertions.
- All three JSON boundaries, exact Unicode path spelling, malformed UTF-8, source corruption and raw certificate-byte mismatch are covered.
- The unchanged selected binding-only baseline and explicit UTF-8 checker/baseline invocations pass.
- Exact committed-byte checking passes for seven package/input files. Official export integrity and declared-input coverage pass. Both Git-free exported replays pass with Windows read-only files, unchanged contents and empty PATH; corrupted source and review-patch controls reject.
- Publication tree `378985908c2138ee3ef33abd956b3cc07fcb8e2e` equals the tested local tree. Full source-history preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout. POSIX execution and full scientific cold replay are not claimed; hosted CI is separate.

### Current main, overlap and credit

Started from canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, priority revision 8. Before publication on October 28, fetched canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`. Guidance, catalogue, selected record and audited source are unchanged. The changed upstream package runner was additionally executed read-only at its logical repository path against this package; both registered commands passed. The package retains its original provenance pins.

The `portable-replay` card came from the verifier-engineering picker, nonce `269949e813c9ca9d693f6a23b2d0d0c2`; TASK.json records the refined scope and stop rule. Handoffs, active Discussions and bounded all-state PR searches were checked. The final targeted updated-PR search returned no matches. Remote helper coverage was unavailable without gh; sparse local note coverage was partial. No exhaustive novelty claim.

This differs from #5973's invoice stdout repair. Credit Douglas Colkitt's selected-checker contract, Mihir Srivastava's baseline, and the codec precedents #2531, #1834 and #2554. Prepared for josecarlosgonzalezroque-design with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent, Apache-2.0.

Open next questions: choose a source-preserving integration policy for the explicit-read patch, and corroborate the same fixtures on native POSIX/another supported Windows interpreter. The five framework assumptions and selected frontier remain unchanged.
